presetNotes.typesafe: Jev directly from TypeSafe: a decision model that scores the conversation against the teacher's goals. Key from console.typesafe.ai.
presetNotes.jevOpenrouter: Jev through OpenRouter: same API as TypeSafe, with your OpenRouter key. The real cost is logged for each call.
presetNotes.gemini: Free tier on Google AI Studio. Required for the live voice mode.
presetNotes.opencode: OpenCode Zen offers free models (big-pickle, GLM, DeepSeek, MiMo, Nemotron…) for a limited time.
presetNotes.jev: Jev is a decision model: it scores the conversation against the teacher's goals. jev-1.13-free is free.
presetNotes.openrouter: Hundreds of models; the ones ending in ':free' cost nothing. Prices are imported automatically.
presetNotes.local: Runs on your own server: free and private. Use host.docker.internal instead of localhost inside Docker.

ai.routingHint: For each task, models are tried in order; if one fails (quota, error) the next is used. When the budget runs out, paid models are skipped.

ai.jevHint: After each student message in an assignment, JEV checks every goal. A goal counts as reached above the threshold.
ai.pricesHint: Used to compute costs. Prices from OpenRouter are imported automatically; local and free models are 0.

legal.note: Base text shipped with the software. The institution installing the platform must complete it with its own details (data controller, contacts, DPO) before using it with students.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s1p: AiDebate.tech is open source software installed on the server of the school or organisation using it. Data stays on that server and is managed by that institution, which is the data controller.
privacy.s2p: For accounts: name, e-mail, role and preferred language; passwords are stored only in hashed form (bcrypt). For activities: classes, assignments, AI conversations, reflections, scores and timing. For cost tracking: the model used and token counts, without the text.
privacy.s3p: Conversation text is sent to the AI provider chosen by the administrator (for example Google Gemini, OpenCode, OpenRouter or a local model). With a local model the data never leaves the server. Do not enter sensitive personal data in conversations.
privacy.s4p: We only use a technical session cookie to keep you signed in. No advertising or profiling cookies.
privacy.s5p: You can ask the institution to access, correct or delete your data. On the Account page you can change your name, language and password.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.s1p: The platform is meant for teacher-led learning activities. Use it in line with your institution's rules and with respect for other users.
terms.s2p: Accounts are created by invitation. You are responsible for your password and for what you do with your account.
terms.s3p: AI answers can contain mistakes or historical inaccuracies. Characters are simulations, not real quotes. Automatic evaluations and scores support the teacher; they are not an official grade.
terms.s4p: The code is published on GitHub. The software is provided as is, without warranty; the institution that installs it is responsible for running it.

personaggioMisterioso.easy: Generous clues: era, country and field come out quickly.
personaggioMisterioso.medium: Fair clues: you'll have to think a bit.
personaggioMisterioso.hard: The character answers only “yes” or “no”: no clues, you need clever questions.
personaggioMisterioso.free: Each student picks the difficulty before starting.

convinciTu.easy: The character is open-minded: a couple of good arguments are enough.
convinciTu.medium: Changes their mind only after several solid arguments.
convinciTu.hard: Stubborn and sharp: takes apart every weak argument.
convinciTu.free: Each student picks the difficulty before starting.

impersonaTu.easy: The character is easy-going: accepts your arguments quickly and helps you.
impersonaTu.medium: Defends their position: changes their mind only with good arguments.
impersonaTu.hard: Extremely stubborn: rebuts everything and gives in only to excellent arguments.
impersonaTu.free: Each student picks the difficulty before starting.
